_comment: JSON-Schema-SUBSET for build_import_emit.py's import-campaign-emit.json (BC-12943, ADR-028 Phase-2 Batch B). Validated by scripts/eval/assert_lib.py — supported keywords ONLY: type (name or list; 'null' matches None), required, properties, additionalProperties:false, items, enum, const. Asserts the matrix SHAPE. manifest is left type-only ([object,null]) so the golden + golden_compare lock the composed manifest's per-branch values: an OK row carries the v2 manifest; a rejection row (a builder-owned input guard, rc 1) carries a null manifest + a non-null error string. The v2-schema validity + 13-key set + the v1-singular-campaign_id-absent anti-regression are asserted as NAMED invariants in the adapter (the campaign_manifest schema is additionalProperties:true, so it can't catch a leaked v1 key).
